title: Thermal gradient-driven heavy metal speciation and risk evolution in municipal and industrial sludge: a 300–700 °C pyrolysis perspective
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43932-43940
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04990C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ke Zhao, Chundi Si, Pei Zhang, Yaning Cui
This work investigated the effect of pyrolysis temperatures (300–700 °C) on the speciation distribution and environmental risks of heavy metals (Cu, Zn, Pb, Cd, Ni, Cr) in biochar derived from municipal sludge (MS) and industrial sludge (IS).
